scope.brief: art-drop/BRIEF-9.md, Part A: 12 standing house/community props in each of four seasons; 48 files total. Part B yard props and all earlier terrain sets are excluded from the verdict.
scope.calibration: Ship alongside the approved markers, round-2 tiles, paddies and seasonal grass/plains. Small-scale simplification is acceptable; noisy, unreadable shapes and inconsistent seasonal behaviour are not.
scope.previous_review: art-drop/review/critic-r9A-0.json does not exist; no previous passes to preserve.
scope.not_applicable: No Part A terrain bases, peak sprites, crater/ruin tiles, cyberpunk tiles or forest-tree sprites exist in BRIEF-9. Peak lattice/range, crater/ruin shape and forest compositing checks therefore have no target files here. Attached side trees were checked in seasonal neighbourhoods and individual magnifications.

checks.individuals: Every target viewed at 1x and exact nearest-neighbour 4x in seasonal all-houses sheets, and at exact 8x in groups 0-3, 4-7, 8-11. The 8x proofs remove only empty top padding, retaining every painted pixel; alternating light/dark backdrops expose fringes.
checks.neighbourhood: Four independently assembled 384x288 seasonal scenes, each with 40 whole props over the matching approved grass and a crossroad from the existing modern road atlas. Viewed at 1x and 4x. Varied setbacks and thinning outskirts produce a calm neighbourhood, without cell frames or a stamped ground grid. A repeated house instance is not counted as a duplicate design.
checks.random_8x2: Four 8-across/2-down random arrangements, each containing all twelve designs and four repeated residential designs. Viewed at 1x/4x. No rectangular sprite backings, join seams, clipped buildings or hidden cell-border artefacts. House 9 remains conspicuously mottled when repeated.
checks.bases_reference_only: Four existing approved grass bases saved as literal unrotated 3x3 repeats at 1x/4x, with separate 4x wrap-junction crops. Overall 1x repeats and 4x junctions checked. Broad ground motifs repeat, but there is no hard boundary attributable to these transparent Part A sprites. No ground receives a new pass/fail verdict.
checks.shape_variety: The twelve designs have distinct footprints/rooflines: squat, dormered, side-tree gable, tall brick, long bungalow/garage, crossed gables, flat roof, porch/tree, broad blue-roof cottage, hip-roof bungalow, awning shop and small turret church. No within-season exact duplicates or rejected near-duplicates. Shop 10 and church 11 supply the two community pieces.
checks.seasons: Architecture and anchors stay registered. All winter roofs carry snow with exposed material/shade rather than blank replacement sprites. Autumn side-tree recolouring is local and shaded, not a flat orange treatment across the whole set. Winter side-tree regressions on 2/7 fail separately.
checks.style: Muted brick, cream, slate and olive colours sit with the approved natural palettes; no cyan/magenta key fringe, palette clash, classical ruins or cyberpunk details. Top-left plane lighting and thin dark contours are adequate on passing files. Roof 9 fails clarity of the planes rather than a set-wide light-direction error.
checks.technical: All 48 files are 48x48 RGBA, alpha exclusively 0/255, each silhouette connected, no detached fringe specks. Painted bounds are horizontally centred within 0.5 px and end at y=46 (one transparent bottom row); total painted widths 15-24 px and heights 13-24 px, with main roof masses around the requested 12-16 px. No interpolated blur or anti-aliased alpha found.

passing_designs.0: Compact warm-roof cottage: recognizable roof, porch and footing at map scale; restrained small detail survives magnification.
passing_designs.1: Dormered slate-roof cottage: low roof silhouette and porch distinguish it from the others; recesses remain readable at the intended size.
passing_designs.2: Clear front gable and side tree; summer/spring/autumn pass. Winter fails the attached tree, not the house.
passing_designs.3: Tall brick house with visible side wall and stacked openings; narrow footprint and blue roof remain distinct in all four seasons.
passing_designs.4: Low, long bungalow with a separate garage/wing; large quiet roof and facade openings remain legible in all seasons.
passing_designs.5: Crossed-gable home retains recognizable roof/wall divisions and a distinct triangular profile, including under snow.
passing_designs.6: Flat-roof brick home has a coherent parapet, roof plane and front door/window cluster; timeless enough for both settings.
passing_designs.7: Porch, roof wings and side tree give a distinct outline; summer/spring/autumn pass. Winter fails the tree returning to green.
passing_designs.8: Broad dark-blue roof, central projecting entry and chimney read clearly; snow leaves shaded/exposed roof material.
passing_designs.10: Striped awning and shopfront distinguish the corner shop without adding modern-only equipment.
passing_designs.11: Small turret and long cream nave distinguish the church from residential cottages; no extra detail needed merely to satisfy an enlarged view.

audit.output_writes: Only art-drop/review/critic-r9A-1-*.png and art-drop/review/critic-r9A-1.json were written in this checkout by this review. No writes to art-drop/out/.

fail.name: suburb-house-9
fail.problems: The broad grey hip roof is peppered with isolated olive/slate pixels and disconnected shade patches instead of a readable ridge, consistent shingle rows and two roof planes. It reads as a dirty mottled dome at 1x in both the neighbourhood and 8x2 proof; 4x/8x show the scattered pixels competing with the already fragmented orange/cream front gables. Consolidate the roof into a light upper-left plane and darker right plane with a clear ridge/eave, remove stray green roof speckles, and group the front windows/walls into clean clusters. Keep the distinct wide footprint. See critic-r9A-1-summer-houses-8-11-8x.png and summer-random-8x2-4x.png.

fail.name: suburb@winter-house-9
fail.problems: The snowy hip roof still has no clear ridge-to-eave structure: irregular grey/tan islands interrupt the cap, and its pale lower edge merges with the cream front gables. At 1x it reads as a lumpy pale mound over orange flecks; 4x/8x confirm weak separation of roof, gables and wall. Rebuild two coherent snow-covered roof planes, retain a continuous shaded eave and exposed slate on the right-facing slope, and simplify the front openings into distinct clusters. Preserve this house's wide footprint. See critic-r9A-1-winter-houses-8-11-8x.png and defect-season-comparison-8x.png.

fail.name: suburb@winter-house-2
fail.problems: The right side tree turns rust/orange in the matching autumn file, establishing a deciduous crown, but winter restores its full summer-green foliage silhouette with only a small snow patch. The green leaf mass is visible at 1x and confirmed at 4x/8x; this is inconsistent seasonal foliage, not an evergreen shrub. Replace that crown with a sparse brown branch silhouette and restrained snow, or a predominantly snow-covered dormant crown; keep the house geometry and correctly snowed roof. See critic-r9A-1-defect-season-comparison-8x.png.
